modern: Be upright, or be made upright.
original: Be thou erect, or be made erect.
notification: Be upright, or be made upright.
notification_original: Be thou erect, or be made erect.

explained.summary: Stand straight on your own, or be propped up by others. Marcus is telling himself that it’s better to be good from your own character than to need correcting, but that if he does go wrong, he should accept being set right.
